scope: proxide_fixer only: NEW FILE sanitizers/hydrogens.rs implementing HydrogenSanitizer with IC-based H placement from FF residue templates
approach: 1. NEW FILE: crates/proxide_fixer/src/sanitizers/hydrogens.rs with HydrogenSanitizer struct, HydrogenError enum, HydrogenReport struct

2. Algorithm per residue: (1) ff.get_residue(name) -> template; (2) diff template H atoms vs present atoms; (3) for each missing H: find parent heavy atom; (4) classify geometry (sp3/sp2/aromatic); (5) place via Nerf::place_atom with CHARMM ideals; (6) append H atom with unique serial
3. Add pub mod hydrogens; to sanitizers/mod.rs
4. TEST: Create fixture no_hydrogens.pdb (heavy-atoms-only tripeptide or stripped clean_small.pdb); assert backbone HN/HA placed, ALA CB gets 3 H, bonds/angles match CHARMM ideals

geometry_rules.sp3_tetrahedral: ~109.5°, e.g. CB methyl (3 H) or backbone HA

geometry_rules.aromatic: in-plane ~120°, e.g. aromatic CH in HIS/PHE/TRP rings

title: Implement Parallel `tmalign_pair`
overview: Introduce a parallel version of `tmalign_pair` using `orx_parallel` to evaluate candidate combinations concurrently, while maintaining the existing serial logic for individual candidate refinement.
success_criteria: `tmalign_pair` and `tmalign_pair_serial` produce identical results on Phase-2 test fixtures
Execution time for `tmalign_pair` is reduced on multi-core systems compared to `tmalign_pair_serial`

steps.description: Implement `tmalign_pair` in `pipeline.rs` using `orx_parallel` to iterate over (seed, gap_open) combinations.
Create a test fixture to compare results of `tmalign_pair` and `tmalign_pair_serial`.

risks.risk: Floating point non-determinism due to reduction order
risks.rollback_path: Revert to `tmalign_pair_serial` if results diverge beyond epsilon.
